record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: Several multi-norms on the group algebra L^1(G) of a locally compact group make it into a multi-Banach algebra. Does this yield interesting information about L^1(G), and which multi-norms have this property?

evidence.quote: Several multi-norms on the group algebra \(L^1(G)\) of a locally compact group give a multi-Banach algebra. Does this lead to any interesting information about \(L^1(G)\) ? Which multi-norms work here?

artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears to be open. It is posed as one of the explicit open problems in the area of multi-norms and multi-Banach algebras, an active research direction initiated by Dales and Polyakov. A dedicated EPSRC research grant ("Multi-norms and multi-Banach algebras") confirms ongoing investigation, and no characterization of multi-norms making L^1(G) a multi-Banach algebra appears in the available literature.
